definitions.explanation: A Japanese confection consisting of two small, round castella-like pancakes sandwiching a filling of sweet red bean paste (anko). A classic Japanese sweet.

examples.japanese: おやつにどら{焼|や}きを{食|た}べた。
examples.english: I had dorayaki for a snack.

examples.japanese: この{店|みせ}のどら{焼|や}きは{皮|かわ}がふわふわだ。
examples.english: The dorayaki at this shop has fluffy pancakes.

examples.japanese: {最近|さいきん}は{抹茶|まっちゃ}クリームや{栗|くり}あんなど、{色々|いろいろ}な{味|あじ}のどら{焼|や}きがある。
examples.english: These days, there are dorayaki in various flavors like matcha cream and chestnut paste.

notes:
A traditional Japanese confection ({和菓子|わがし}). The standard filling is {小豆|あずき}{餡|あん} (sweet red bean paste), but modern variations include cream, matcha, and fruit fillings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- どら{焼|や}きの{皮|かわ} (dorayaki pancake/wrapper)
- どら{焼|や}きの{餡|あん} (dorayaki filling)
- {生|なま}どら{焼|や}き (fresh dorayaki, often with whipped cream)

ETYMOLOGY: The name is said to come from {銅鑼|どら} (gong), because the shape of the pancakes resembles a small gong.

CULTURAL NOTE: Dorayaki gained international recognition as the favorite food of the manga character ドラえもん.
